description: Strata memory: recall at session start, capture and consolidate at session end, context handoff near a full context window

hooks.command: for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/strata.py" hook session-start; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done; exit 0
for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/strata.py" hook context-check; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/strata.py" hook context-check; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/strata.py" hook pre-compact; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; done; exit 0
for p in py python3 python; do command -v $p >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; $p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/strata.py" hook session-end; rc=$?; case $rc in 3|49) ;; *) exit $rc;; esac; done; exit 0
